slots.name: title
slots.about: the app's name, the screen title

slots.name: subject
slots.about: what is being discussed, the largest line

slots.name: byline
slots.about: one line under it, like who posted it

slots.name: comments
slots.about: the thread in reading order (each reply right after its parent's branch): id, parent (0 for top level), author, date, text; up to 4 levels deep

slots.name: today_word
slots.about: the age of a comment from today

slots.name: days_word
slots.about: after the day count for older comments, e.g. 'd'

slots.name: reply_one
slots.about: after the count when there is one reply, e.g. ' reply'

slots.name: reply_many
slots.about: after the count otherwise, e.g. ' replies'

slots.name: count_word
slots.about: after the comment count under the subject

slots.name: more_text
slots.about: the link that opens a long comment

slots.name: less_text
slots.about: the link that clamps it again

slots.name: hide_label
slots.about: spoken before the author on a branch's fold button while open

slots.name: show_label
slots.about: spoken before the author on a branch's fold button while folded

attention.shows: folded branches gone, their parent's chevron down

accessibility.reduce_motion: the phone drops the smooth fold, shrink and swap
